//: Dependency license allowlist for JS and Python. Read by scripts/check-licenses.mjs (`pnpm run licenses`, `pnpm run licenses:py`) and enforced by the CI `licenses` job.

pythonAliases.//: Older Python packages report a trove classifier name instead of an SPDX id. Each name maps to the allowlisted id it stands for.

exceptions.//: Packages exempt from the allowlist, by name, each with the reason. Keep this list short.

js.caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0. Browser-support data read by build tooling (browserslist) at build time; not shipped in any bundle.
js.lightningcss: MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft). CSS transformer required by Vite and Tailwind at build time; used unmodified and not shipped in any bundle.
js.spdx-exceptions: CC-BY-3.0. SPDX data file used only by the license checker itself.
js.spdx-ranges: MIT AND CC-BY-3.0. SPDX data file used only by the license checker itself.

python.psycopg: LGPL-3.0-only. The PostgreSQL driver required by #2; used unmodified as a dynamically imported library, which LGPL permits.
python.psycopg-binary: LGPL-3.0-only. Prebuilt wheels for psycopg; same reasoning.
